paper-start.title: Paper server requirements
paper-start.note: Version table separates Java 21-era Minecraft releases from Java 25-era releases; never copy current defaults into older targets.

paper-setup.title: Paper project setup
paper-setup.note: Rolling examples use newer dependency coordinates; pin API and toolchain to requested release.

plugin-yml.title: Paper plugin descriptors
plugin-yml.note: Plugin metadata, API compatibility, commands and permission defaults belong in the correct descriptor.

commands.title: Paper command registration
commands.note: Lifecycle registration supports Brigadier commands; classic descriptors and Paper bootstrapping are distinct choices.

events.title: Paper event listeners
events.note: Cancellation and priorities affect cooperation with other plugins; observer handlers should not mutate results.

scheduler.title: Paper scheduling
scheduler.note: Ticks are simulation time; normal Bukkit world access is not made safe merely by moving it off-thread.

folia.title: Paper and Folia scheduling
folia.note: Entity, region, global and async responsibilities differ; setting support metadata does not establish safety.

dialog.title: Paper Dialog API
dialog.note: Native Dialog bodies, inputs and custom callbacks are supported; implementation must be checked against target version.

inventory.title: Custom InventoryHolders
inventory.note: Menu identity can be carried by a holder rather than guessed from display titles.

inventory-event.title: InventoryClickEvent contract
inventory-event.note: Versioned reference example: menu mutations during a click require attention to event transaction timing.

pdc.title: Persistent data containers
pdc.note: Namespaced metadata belongs on supported holders; normal blocks and item lore are not equivalent storage mechanisms.

components.title: Paper data components
components.note: Component APIs are version-specific; prefer stable metadata interfaces where sufficient.

config.title: Plugin configuration
config.note: Malformed/missing configuration can otherwise resemble an empty configuration; distinguish configuration failure from defaults.

database.title: Using databases
database.note: Embedded and standalone database choices differ; JDBC is an API and does not supply every database driver.

recipes.title: Paper recipes
recipes.note: Namespaced recipe registration is available; ingredient behavior must match the chosen recipe interface.

display.title: Display entities
display.note: Displays provide visual transforms/interpolation; they do not automatically provide gameplay interaction or collision.

profile.title: Paper profiling
profile.note: Modern Paper bundles spark; profile real load before changing tick-heavy systems.

update.title: Paper updates
update.note: Upgrade worlds and plugins with a restorable backup; source/build compatibility is separate from data compatibility.

packs.title: Adventure resource-pack delivery
packs.note: Pack delivery uses URLs, identities and statuses; status replies are client-controlled and are not an integrity proof.

localization.title: Adventure localization
localization.note: Client resource-pack translation and server translation differ; rendering policy must identify which side owns the text.

minimessage.title: Safe dynamic MiniMessage replacements
minimessage.note: Use unparsed or component placeholders for untrusted strings rather than allowing formatting/action injection.

release-12111.title: Minecraft Java 1.21.11 release notes
release-12111.note: Historical example only: release notes record resource/data format changes and item/block atlas constraints; not a global target version.

release-1219.title: Java Edition 1.21.9 release notes
release-1219.note: Official rolling documentation; resolve target release before using symbols.

worldgen.title: ChunkGenerator contract
worldgen.note: Versioned example: generation callbacks need thread safety and must not recursively fetch their generating chunk.

harvest.title: PlayerHarvestBlockEvent
harvest.note: Right-click harvest has a distinct event; block break is not every crop interaction.

age.title: Block Ageable
age.note: Crop age is block data, distinct from entity Ageable; use material-specific maximum age.

breed.title: EntityBreedEvent
breed.note: Breeding can be observed/cancelled; persistence, attribution and custom traits remain application responsibilities.

damage.title: EntityDamageByEntityEvent
damage.note: Damage event exposes source interactions; protection and projectile attribution need separate handling.

scoreboard.title: Scoreboard Objective
scoreboard.note: Native scoreboard supplies objectives and display slots; arbitrary pixel positioning is not part of this interface.

worldedit.title: WorldEdit clipboard and schematic API
worldedit.note: Clipboard origin, transforms, format readers and EditSession lifetime matter when pasting.

worldguard.title: WorldGuard protection queries
worldguard.note: Use flag-aware protection queries; bypass handling is separate from region membership.

sponge.title: Sponge schematic v3 specification
sponge.note: Sponge format is its own schema; it is not interchangeable with Litematica or vanilla structure NBT.

litematica.title: Litematica author repository
litematica.note: Author implementation is authoritative for litematic serialization; exact packing/version constants must be read from the target branch before writing a serializer.

bentobox.title: BentoBox documentation
bentobox.note: Existing island/blueprint infrastructure should be evaluated before writing a complete island platform.

fabric.title: Fabric project setup
fabric.note: Generator accepts target Minecraft version; loader/API/Loom and mappings must be selected together.

fabric-net.title: Fabric networking
fabric-net.note: Logical client/server payload handling and validation are separate from singleplayer appearance.

datagen.title: Fabric data generation
datagen.note: Datagen produces version-specific JSON for recipes, tags and assets; generated output is still validated by the game.

neoforge.title: NeoForge project setup
neoforge.note: Use the target-version toolchain and event model; Fabric and NeoForge APIs are not drop-in replacements.

neoforge-net.title: NeoForge payload registration
neoforge-net.note: Payload registration, execution thread and size limits are explicit versioned contracts.

attachments.title: NeoForge data attachments
attachments.note: Persistent and synchronized attachments differ; death cloning and End return must not duplicate state.

vault.title: VaultAPI author repository
vault.note: Vault bridges economy providers; withdrawal responses and provider availability must be checked.

luckperms.title: LuckPerms developer API
luckperms.note: Use provider APIs and context-sensitive permission queries; changes to account state need supported persistence.

velocity-security.title: Velocity backend security
velocity-security.note: Offline backend authentication requires network isolation and trusted forwarding; forwarding alone is not a firewall.

velocity-forwarding.title: Velocity player forwarding
velocity-forwarding.note: Forwarding mode must agree with backend configuration and installed platform support.

geyser-packs.title: Geyser resource packs
geyser-packs.note: Java resource packs are not automatically converted to Bedrock packs.

geyser-items.title: Geyser custom items
geyser-items.note: Custom item models require version-compatible mappings and separate Bedrock assets.

mockbukkit.title: MockBukkit author repository
mockbukkit.note: Mock API coverage does not prove packet behavior, native registries or client rendering.

create.title: Create author repository
create.note: Automation design reference; Create is a mod and cannot be installed as an ordinary Paper plugin.

usage.title: Minecraft usage guidelines
usage.note: Review current first-party rules when the actual task concerns monetization, branding or distribution; no blanket legal clearance.

text-access.title: Microsoft game text guidance
text-access.note: Readability depends on actual rendered size and display conditions, not only logical font size.

contrast-access.title: Microsoft game contrast guidance
contrast-access.note: Contrast and non-color cues support readability and status recognition; screenshots alone do not establish full accessibility conformance.

bedrock-start.title: Bedrock add-on introduction
bedrock-start.note: Bedrock resource/behavior packs and add-on packaging differ from Java assets and datapacks.

bedrock-script.title: Bedrock server Script API
bedrock-script.note: Stable and preview Script API surfaces need matching module dependencies and engine support.

paper-vanilla.title: Paper vanilla compatibility
paper-vanilla.note: Paper can differ from vanilla simulation; technical contraptions and adventure maps need target-runtime testing.

mob-goals.title: Paper mob goals
mob-goals.note: Goal priorities, behavior types and lifecycle matter; goals are constrained by mob capabilities.

pathfinder.title: Paper entity pathfinder
pathfinder.note: Navigation requests can fail; native movement rules still apply.

teleport.title: Paper teleportation
teleport.note: Async teleport avoids blocking chunk loads; blocking its future on the tick thread can deadlock.

team.title: Paper Team API: versioned example
team.note: Presentation teams expose friendly-fire and collision options but do not replace authoritative group membership/permissions.

advancement.title: Paper AdvancementProgress: versioned example
advancement.note: Criteria award/revocation and completion are platform contracts; reward uniqueness remains application policy.

redstone.title: Paper BlockRedstoneEvent: versioned example
redstone.note: Current-change events are one hook; they are not a complete simulation/transfer log.

fabric-attributes.title: Fabric entity attributes
fabric-attributes.note: Attribute registration and modifiers depend on target mappings and game release.

neoforge-attributes.title: NeoForge entity attributes
neoforge-attributes.note: Attribute applicability, registration and synchronization require version-aware verification; do not copy every table claim as a tested formula.

bedrock-world.title: Bedrock World API
bedrock-world.note: Native dimensions, events and world access differ from Java platforms and have lifecycle restrictions.

codex-agents.title: Official OpenAI subagent documentation
codex-agents.note: Subagent availability, orchestration and sandbox behavior are host-specific; current tools and instructions govern execution.

codex-instructions.title: Official OpenAI AGENTS.md guidance
codex-instructions.note: Instruction scope follows repository hierarchy; reusable skills must not silently rewrite global or project policy.

agent-skills.title: Agent Skills specification
agent-skills.note: Official rolling documentation; resolve target release before using symbols.

purpur.title: Purpur documentation
purpur.note: Official rolling documentation; resolve target release before using symbols.

spigot-build.title: Spigot BuildTools
spigot-build.note: Official rolling documentation; resolve target release before using symbols.

velocity-start.title: Velocity getting started
velocity-start.note: Official rolling documentation; resolve target release before using symbols.

forge-start.title: Forge getting started
forge-start.note: Official rolling documentation; resolve target release before using symbols.
